experiment_data.assay_type: KESTREL (kinase substrate tracking and elucidation) screen
experiment_data.method_description: A KESTREL screen in rat brain extracts to identify proteins that were phosphorylated by an activated PD mutant of LRRK2 (G2019S).

negative_positive_control.positive_control_description: WT LRRK2 was implicitly used as a baseline for comparison with the activated G2019S mutant in this screen.

experiment_data.assay_type: Phosphorylation assay using mosein or MBP as substrates
experiment_data.method_description: Assays were set up in a total volume of 25 µl of Buffer A containing 0.5–0.7 µg of either wild-type or mutant forms of LRRK2, 1 µM moesin or 1 µM MBP, 10 mM MgCl2 and 0.1 mM [γ -32P]ATP.

negative_positive_control.negative_control_description: Kinase-inactive LRRK2[D2017A] was used as a negative control.
negative_positive_control.positive_control_description: Wild-type LRRK2 was used as a positive control.
